name: ^readS3Text$
reason: S3 object read; the twin checks bucket and key, and the stored text is the only answer.

name: ^collectSecretValues$
reason: Collector in shared/log; the twin checks the exact values passed and only appends the user credential.

name: ^performance\.now$
reason: Clock read whose value is passed on unchanged to confirmOwner.

name: ^runtime\.mutate$
reason: Convex mutation; the twin checks function name and argument, and only reads the returned sequence.

name: ^new Date$
reason: Clock read that is passed on unchanged into the prompt formatter.

name: ^getTracer$
reason: OpenTelemetry tracer accessor; the tracer is only passed through.

name: ^tracer\.startSpan$
reason: OpenTelemetry span start; the twin checks name, options and parent.

name: ^span\.spanContext$
reason: Read of span ids, each checked for all zeros by the twin.

name: ^mintTraceId$
reason: Random id generator; only its output is forwarded.

name: ^mintSpanId$
reason: Random id generator; only its output is forwarded.

name: ^otelTraceApi\.setSpan$
reason: OpenTelemetry context helper; result only passed through.

name: ^createCodex$
reason: Third party harness factory; the twin checks every option passed.

name: ProxyTracer
reason: OpenTelemetry tracer, only passed through.

name: ProxyTracerProvider
reason: OpenTelemetry provider inside a tracer, only passed through.

name: NonRecordingSpan
reason: OpenTelemetry span, only passed through.

name: BaseContext
reason: OpenTelemetry context, only passed through.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: Clock read passed on unchanged.

name: ^session\.(flushPendingStoredEvents|loadHarnessSession|loadHarnessSkills|environmentText|secretValues|compactConversation)$
reason: Methods of the session passed in; each has its own twin, or a test double in these recordings.

name: ^options\.(applySteering|createAgent|onOccupied|abortController\.abort)$
reason: Callbacks and controller the caller supplies; the twin checks their arguments.

name: ^options \.openSession$
reason: Callback the caller supplies to open the harness session; arguments are checked.

name: ^stopLeaseMonitor$
reason: Stop function returned by startHarnessLeaseMonitor; takes no argument.

name: AbortController
reason: Platform abort controller, only passed through.
